description: This file defines the PostgreSQLQueryService class, which implements database query operations specific to PostgreSQL, such as checking table existence, retrieving table columns, and indexes.

classes.name: PostgreSQLQueryService
classes.description: A service class providing PostgreSQL-specific database query functionalities, such as checking table existence, retrieving column details, and index information.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current database is PostgreSQL.

methods.name: isTablePresent
methods.description: Determines if a specific table exists in the database.

methods.name: getTableColumns
methods.description: Retrieves column definitions for a specified table.

methods.name: getTableIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index details for a specified table.
